verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented retention period, auto-deletion, or user-triggered deletion of uploaded files, checkpoints, or results. File storage (docs-37) and checkpoint saving (docs-29) show that data is retained, but nothing shows a control over how long it is kept or how to delete it. On-prem deployment and the BAA/DPA on the Team plan are adjacent privacy options, not product retention or deletion controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
